requirement.clarified: Replace the hardcoded MAX_CONTEXT_SIZE = 190000 constant with a per-model context-window lookup. For any Claude model key matching the 1M naming convention, use 1,000,000 as the denominator; for all other Claude models, use 200,000. Thread the resolved maximum into getContextWarning so the status-bar N% left is computed correctly for every 1M session.
requirement.what: Per-model context-window denominator for the status-bar context-usage percentage
requirement.why: For 1M-context Claude sessions contextSize easily exceeds 190000, causing percentageUsed > 100 and percentageRemaining clamping to 0, producing the impossible 0% left display

included: Update getContextWarning signature to accept maxContextSize parameter
Thread resolved model key (with currentModelCode fallback) to the call site
excluded: Codex / Gemini context window sizes (out of scope for this requirement)

success_criteria: A 1M-context session with 500k tokens shows approximately 50% left, not 0%
Non-1M sessions continue to show correct percentages (no regression)
Warning thresholds (<=5% critical, <=10% warning) fire at the correct percentage values
constraints: Context window sizes must come from official Anthropic documentation (tier_1_external), not from internal pricing.ts or other secondary sources
getModelContextWindow must handle both shorthand picker keys ('opus', 'sonnet', 'haiku') and raw server model IDs ('claude-opus-4-7-20260301-1m')
When modelMode.key is 'default', must fall through to metadata.currentModelCode for 1M detection

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Status bar shows '0% left' for 1M-context Claude sessions regardless of actual token usage
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: MAX_CONTEXT_SIZE is hardcoded to 190000 in AgentInput.tsx:85 and used as the sole denominator for every model. For 1M sessions contextSize >> 190000, so percentageUsed >> 100 and Math.max(0, 100 - percentageUsed) = 0.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — the constant has been present since the initial happy-app implementation; no single regression commit
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The constant was likely set to ~190000 as a conservative approximation for Claude 200k-context models (200000 minus a ~5% safety buffer). At introduction time, 1M-context models may not have been supported.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: 1M-context model variants now appear in the picker and are actively used. Their contextSize can be orders of magnitude above 190000, trivially exceeding the cap.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Present since initial AgentInput implementation; became user-visible when 1M Claude model variants were added to the model picker

root_cause_analysis.localization_evidence: User's screenshot shows status bar rendering '0% left' on a 1M-context session. Code path is: SessionView.tsx:454 maps session.latestUsage to usageData → AgentInput.tsx:357-359 computes contextWarning using getContextWarning(contextSize, alwaysShow, theme) → AgentInput.tsx:292-304 getContextWarning divides by MAX_CONTEXT_SIZE=190000 → percentageRemaining clamps to 0. Single-file, single-constant root cause.

git_bisect_result.bisect_blocked: Not a regression bug — the constant has been present since initial implementation; user is reporting a limitation that became apparent when 1M models were added. No bisect needed.
